story: Kofi and his brother Max sit in the park. The evening air is warm because the sun is out. Max eats an apple, but he does not want other food. He thinks English is difficult, but Kofi helps him with everything.
title: A Warm Evening

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: A young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Max
characters.look: A young boy with glasses and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Kofi and his brother Max sit outside.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a boy in a blue shirt, and Max, a boy in a green sweater, sit on a park bench.

sentences.en: The evening air is very warm.
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi and Max sit in a park under a soft orange sky.

sentences.en: The air is warm because of the sun.
sentences.zh: 因为有太阳，空气很温暖。
sentences.scene_prompt: A bright yellow sun shines in the orange sky above the park.

sentences.en: Max eats a big red apple.
sentences.scene_prompt: Max, a boy with glasses, bites into a large red apple.

sentences.en: He does not want other food now.
sentences.zh: 他现在不想吃其他的食物。
sentences.scene_prompt: Max looks at the apple in his hand and shakes his head.

sentences.en: English is more difficult than play.
sentences.scene_prompt: Max looks at a book with a sad face.

sentences.en: Somebody helps him with everything now.
sentences.zh: 现在有人在帮他处理一切。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi puts his hand on Max's shoulder.

sentences.en: The right answers include many words.
sentences.zh: 正确的答案包含很多单词。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi points to a word in the book held by Max.
